April 23, 1927.

REPORT ON Watching Suspicious Characters Coming to Shanghai.

Made by C.D.I. Givens. Forwarded by

Sir,

I beg to forward herewith a comprehensive report
by Detective Inspector Yorke regarding the checking of passengers
arriving in Shanghai by steamers. It is my opinion that the
work could be effectively carried out by four male and two female
European detectives and six male and two female temporary agents.
The success of the scheme will, however, largely depend upon the
amount of assistance which these officers will receive from other
Authorities. Consequently I beg to make the following
recommendations.

(I) That an arrangement be made whereby the Police will receive
complete support from the members of the Consular Body, whose
subjects enjoy extraterritorial rights, and owners of wharves
where ships dock.

(2) That arrangements be made with shipping companies to instruct
the masters of ships to furnish a representative of the
Municipal Police on arrival in Shanghai, with a full list of
all passengers disembarking here and the following
particulars about each individual: (a) his name and nationali-
ty, (b) his business and the name and address of his
employers (c) the place where he intends to reside in
Shanghai and the name of a local permanent resident to
whom he is known.

(3) That shipping companies and the Chinese Customs make an
arrangement whereby all passengers coming to Shanghai will
be obliged to land at a wharf or jetty where, in accordance
with the above arrangements, the Police can interview the

关于监视抵沪可疑人物的报告。

由刑事检举股督察吉文斯（C.D.I. Givens）呈报。转呈者

阁下：

谨此转呈约克侦探督察（Detective Inspector Yorke）关于核查乘轮船抵达上海乘客的综合报告。本人认为，此项工作可由四名男性及两名女性欧洲籍侦探，以及六名男性及两名女性临时探员有效开展。然而，该方案的成功将在很大程度上取决于这些警员从其他当局获得的协助程度。因此，谨提出以下建议。

(1) 作出安排，使警方获得享有治外法权国家的领事团成员，以及船舶停靠码头的业主的全面支持。

(2) 与轮船公司作出安排，指示各船船长在抵达上海时，向工部局警务处代表提供所有在此下船乘客的完整名单，以及关于每个人的下列详情：(a) 姓名及国籍，(b) 职业及雇主名称和地址，(c) 拟在上海居住的地方，以及其在上海所认识的一位本地常住居民的姓名。

(3) 轮船公司与中国海关作出安排，使所有来沪乘客必须在某一码头或栈桥登陆，以便根据上述安排，警方可对乘客进行面谈，

(4) That the French Police and Chinese Authorities be induced
to make similar arrangements.
The attainment of the object in view must depend
largely on the effectiveness attained in maintaining surveillance
over the suspicious characters discovered in the course of
the checking process, subsequent to their arrival in the
Settlement. I, therefore, further recommend that the following
measures be adopted to facilitate this work:-
(I) That all foreign boarding houses be compelled to take out
licenses and to furnish lists of their lodgers to the
Municipal Police weekly.
(2) That clause 18 of Hotel licenses be altered to read as
follows:
"That the licensee keep on the premises a permanent
"accurate and legible register of the name, nationality
"occupation, place of employment, last address,
"destination and date of arrival and departure, of all
"persons resorting to, or using the premises, which
"register shall be open to inspection at all times
"by the Police or other duly authorized officers of
"the Council.

（批：Why not include the licensees of the Chinese hotels? The list ought to be furnished daily.）

I am, Sir,
Your Obedient Servant,
McEwen
C. C. D. I.

A.C. (C.I.D.)

(4) 促使法国警方及中国当局作出类似安排。
既定目标的实现，在很大程度上取决于在可疑人物抵达租界后，在核查过程中被发现的可疑人物维持监视的有效性。因此，本人进一步建议采取以下措施以便利此项工作：-
(1) 强制所有外籍寄宿公寓领取执照，并每周向工部局警务处提供住客名单。
(2) 旅馆执照第18条应修改如下：
“持照人须在场所内保存一份永久、准确且字迹清晰的登记簿，记录所有光顾或使用该场所人员的姓名、国籍、职业、工作地点、最后住址、目的地以及抵达和离开日期，该登记簿须随时供警方或公部局其他 duly authorized officers（正式授权官员）检查。”

（批注：为何不包括中国旅馆的持照人？名单应当每日提供。）

April 22, 1937.

REPORT ON Observation on arrival and subsequent action of
suspicious characters:

Made by D. I. Yorke Forwarded by [Signature] C.D.I.

Sir,
No definite arrangements exist in the C.I.D.
for observing the arrival, and subsequent movements of suspicious
characters, be they foreign or Chinese.
Many enquiries are however instituted regarding suspected
persons on information received (1) officially at Police
Headquarters, (2) through the medium of newspapers or
journalists connected with newspaper offices, and (3) privately
by detectives. On receipt of such information, detectives, foreign
or Chinese as the merits of the enquiry demand, are detailed to
visit the wharf or railway station where the suspected person
will arrive and it is, in almost every case, then left to the
foreign detective in charge of the enquiry to arrange for any
watch on the movements and subsequent actions of the suspect.
The senior detective attached to the Police District in which the
wharf or railway station is situated or adjoins, is sometimes
detailed to conduct an enquiry of this nature, but the greater
part of this work is done from the Intelligence Office.
European, Japanese and Chinese detectives are instructed to
visit wharves when not otherwise engaged and observe the arrival
and departure of passengers, but these visits are spasmodic
and very irregular owing to their [del. day] being occupied with other matters
of duty.

A Chinese detective is constantly employed at the Shanghai-
Nanking Railway North Station in normal times, but he is
primarily there to observe the movements of Chinese military.
It will thus be seen that, with the system now prevailing, no

关于对可疑人物抵达及后续行动的观察报告：

由侦探督察约克（D. I. Yorke）制作 转呈人 [签名] 首席侦探督察（C.D.I.）

阁下：
刑事检举股（C.I.D.）目前并无明确安排来观察可疑人物（无论是外籍还是华人）的抵达及后续动向。
然而，基于收到的信息，针对嫌疑人的许多调查得以展开：(1) 在警察总局正式接收的信息，(2) 通过报纸或与报社有关的记者媒介获得的信息，以及 (3) 侦探私下获取的信息。收到此类信息后，视调查需要，会指派外籍或华人侦探前往嫌疑人即将抵达的码头或火车站，而在几乎每种情况下，随后对嫌疑人行动及后续行为的任何监视安排，均由负责该调查的外籍侦探自行决定。有时也会指派码头或火车站所在或相邻警区的资深侦探进行此类调查，但大部分此类工作是由情报办公室完成的。
欧洲籍、日本籍和华人籍侦探被指示在未执行其他任务时前往码头，观察乘客的抵达和离开，但由于他们[删除：日常]忙于其他警务工作，这些走访是零散且极不规则的。

一名华人侦探在正常时期常驻上海-南京铁路北站，但他主要在那里观察中国军队的动向。

目前，由于许多船只在中国领土内的码头停泊和离港，外籍侦探无法前往，因此无法对所有进出上海的轮船维持密切且令人满意的监视。

对于在国际租界和法租界码头停泊或离港的所有轮船，可由三名外籍侦探和八名华人探员组成的 staff（班子）进行观察，并偶尔由一名印籍警员协助。依本人之见，在此项工作中临时雇佣华人作为探员，比雇佣他们担任侦探更为妥当，因为最近已证明，一名服务数年的华人侦探并不喜欢被分配至情报办公室的工作。侦探深知，如果表现不佳，他将被调往一个工作内容更合心意的巡捕房，因此在这项工作上不会竭尽全力；而按日薪工作的探员，如果服务不能令人满意，则面临被解雇的风险。
